children: Loop Industries appointed Jeff Geygan as Chairman of the Board while founder Daniel Solomita remains CEO to focus on commercial execution.
Jeff Geygan named Chairman; Board separates Chair and CEO roles to strengthen governance.
Daniel Solomita continues as CEO and Director, concentrating on commercializing technology and project execution.
Solomita will lead projects in India and Europe, strategic partnerships, customer relations and financing strategy.
Geygan brings capital-markets and public-company governance experience and aligns with shareholders as Chairman of a significant investor.
